title: Toxic Slime Villain Kid
description: A young boy stands centered against a bright green background with arms outstretched, wearing a full-body purple and black villain costume covered in dripping green slime. His outfit includes a black helmet with large yellow eyes, spiked shoulder pads, a skull emblem on the chest, a belt of green orbs, knee pads with smiley faces, and heavy purple boots; he holds a spiked green mace in his right hand while a long tentacle tail extends from his back.
